nom: medicube Azelaic Acid Niacinamide Deep Clean Whip Cleanser

avis.texte: I bought this when it was on sale cheap on tiktok shop and use it every morning. I love the way it feels on my skin leaving it so soft and smooth.

I use this as the second step in my double cleanse. This is the only product that has ever, in the past 30 years, helped to smooth out the sebaceous filament bumps under my lip area on my chin. I have used a number of other active ingredient products that were either ineffective or too harsh (and still ineffective for those bumps). After using this daily for 2 weeks, I am blown away at these results. And to top it off, the texture of the foam is like a marshmallow cloud, and it rinses off so gently, leaving my skin soft and not the least bit stripped. I am not paid, did not receive as a free sample—I bought this on a whim and need to share in case this can help someone else's sensitive, troubled skin!
